title: ParcelStatusChangedEventV1
description: Domain event published by Delivery Operations transactional outbox when a parcel undergoes an authoritative status transition.

eventId.description: Globally unique identifier for this domain event instance (used for consumer deduplication).

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the event envelope and payload schema (major version 1).

aggregateId.description: UUID of the parcel aggregate root (corresponds to Kafka partition key).

aggregateVersion.description: Monotonically increasing version of the parcel aggregate at the time of this transition.

occurredAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp recording when the status transition was committed.

correlationId.description: Trace or correlation identifier propagated from the incoming command request.

producer.description: Authoritative service producing this lifecycle event.

oldStatus.description: Previous lifecycle state (null if initial CREATED transition).

reason.description: Mandatory failure reason code when newStatus is FAILED; null otherwise.

merchantId.description: Opaque tenant identifier if booked by a commercial merchant; null for direct retail customers.

courierSub.description: Keycloak subject of the assigned courier who performed the transition; null if transition was system or customer triggered.

cityOrZone.description: Coarse geographic location or hub name for tracking display (zero street-level PII).
